                  <div id="shopify-block-AK21LTjlIVW9wRkMzS__live_visitors_counter_pvc_product_Hnhrrm" class="shopify-block shopify-app-block">

  

  

  
<div
      id="pvc-widget-AK21LTjlIVW9wRkMzS__live_visitors_counter_pvc_product_Hnhrrm"
      class="pvc-widget "style="
        
        
"
    ></div>
    <script>
      (function() {
        var apiBase = "https:\/\/app.visitorscounter.app";
        var shopUrl = 'natashadenona.myshopify.com';
        var productId = '8729235587246';var widgetId = 'pvc-widget-AK21LTjlIVW9wRkMzS__live_visitors_counter_pvc_product_Hnhrrm';
        var minViewers = 1;
        var textTemplate = "\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003e🔥VISITORS_COUNT People looked at this product today\u003c\/span\u003e\u003c\/p\u003e";
        var uniquenessEnabled = false;
        var expiryHours = 24;
        var refreshId = 1;
        var labelImageUrl = "";

        if (!apiBase) { return; }

        try {
          // The image goes BEFORE the text, in actual DOM order (not CSS order) -
          // since the whole widget's innerHTML is replaced on every render, the
          // image has to be composed into that same string each time rather than
          // placed once as static Liquid markup, or it would be wiped out the first
          // time the count renders. labelImageUrl is either a real Shopify CDN
          // https:// URL (an uploaded file - rendered as an <img>) or a raw HTML
          // snippet (an animated CSS preset) - rendered as-is, same dual-mode design
          // as LIS's lis_label_image_url. Wiggle/blink (pvc_awareness_class) is
          // applied to the whole #pvc-widget - icon and text together - matching
          // LIS's lisAwareness behaviour.
          var imageHtml = '';
          if (labelImageUrl) {
            if (labelImageUrl.indexOf('http') > -1) {
              imageHtml = '<img alt="" class="pvc-widget-image" src="' + labelImageUrl + '">';
            } else {
              imageHtml = labelImageUrl;
            }
          }

          var renderCount = function(count) {
            var n = parseInt(count || 0);
            if (isNaN(n) || n < parseInt(minViewers)) { return; }
            var el = document.getElementById(widgetId);
            if (el) { el.innerHTML = imageHtml + textTemplate.replace('VISITORS_COUNT', n); }
          };

          // 1) Decide whether this visit counts, BEFORE calling anything. Deciding
          // first means exactly one request per page load instead of two - the old
          // order fetched the count, then incremented, and the first value was thrown
          // away a moment later for every visitor who was going to be counted.
          var shouldIncrement = true;

          // A section re-render re-runs this script in the same page load; don't let
          // that count as a second visit.
          var debounceKey = '__pvcIncremented_' + productId;
          if (window[debounceKey] && (Date.now() - window[debounceKey]) < 3000) {
            shouldIncrement = false;
          }

          if (shouldIncrement && uniquenessEnabled === true) {
            var key = 'effectiveAppsPVC_' + productId + '_' + String(refreshId);
            var now = new Date();
            var utcNow = Date.UTC(
              now.getUTCFullYear(), now.getUTCMonth(), now.getUTCDate(),
              now.getUTCHours(), now.getUTCMinutes(), now.getUTCSeconds(), now.getUTCMilliseconds()
            );
            var storedTs = localStorage.getItem(key);
            if (storedTs !== null) {
              var stored = parseInt(storedTs);
              if (!isNaN(stored) && utcNow < stored) {
                shouldIncrement = false;
              }
            }
            if (shouldIncrement === true) {
              var futureMs = utcNow + (parseInt(expiryHours) || 0) * 60 * 60 * 1000;
              localStorage.setItem(key, String(futureMs));
            }
          }

          // 2) One call. Counting -> increment and show what the server returns.
          if (shouldIncrement) {
            window[debounceKey] = Date.now();
            fetch(apiBase + '/visitors/increment', {
              method: 'POST',
              headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
              body: JSON.stringify({ shop_url: shopUrl, product_id: productId })
            }).then(function(r){ return r.json(); }).then(function(json){
              if (!json || json.result !== 'success') { return; }
              renderCount(json.visitor_count);
              try {
                sessionStorage.setItem('effectiveAppsPVC_current_' + productId,
                  JSON.stringify({ v: parseInt(json.visitor_count || 0), t: Date.now() }));
              } catch (e) {}
            }).catch(function(){});
            return;
          }

          // Not counting (returning visitor, or a re-render): read only. This is the
          // only case that needs /visitors/current at all.
          var cacheKey = 'effectiveAppsPVC_current_' + productId;
          try {
            var raw = sessionStorage.getItem(cacheKey);
            if (raw) {
              var cached = JSON.parse(raw);
              if (cached && (Date.now() - cached.t) < 60000) {
                renderCount(cached.v);
                return;
              }
            }
          } catch (e) {}

          fetch(apiBase + '/visitors/current?shop_url=' + encodeURIComponent(shopUrl) + '&product_id=' + encodeURIComponent(productId), {
            method: 'GET',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
          }).then(function(r){ return r.json(); }).then(function(json){
            if (!json || json.result !== 'success') { return; }
            renderCount(json.visitor_count);
            try {
              sessionStorage.setItem(cacheKey,
                JSON.stringify({ v: parseInt(json.visitor_count || 0), t: Date.now() }));
            } catch (e) {}
          }).catch(function(){});
        } catch (e) {}
      })();
    </script>
  



</div>

<script>
  (function() {
    var ctaEl = document.querySelector('.yotpo-widget-spotlight-cta[data-block-id="AYkg0QVBpcy9jRExkS__yotpo_loyalty_rewards_spotlight_cta_app_block_UaKDWy"]');
    if (!ctaEl) {
      return;
    }

    var excludePatterns = "";

    function matchesPattern(path, pattern) {
      if (!pattern.includes('*')) {
        return path === pattern;
      }
      var regexPattern = pattern
        .replace(/\*\*/g, '___DOUBLE_WILDCARD___')
        .replace(/\*/g, '___SINGLE_WILDCARD___')
        .replace(/[.+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')
        .replace(/___SINGLE_WILDCARD___/g, '[^/]*')
        .replace(/___DOUBLE_WILDCARD___/g, '.*');
      regexPattern = '^' + regexPattern + '$';
      return new RegExp(regexPattern).test(path);
    }

    function shouldHideButton(currentPath, patterns) {
      if (!patterns || String(patterns).trim() === '') {
        return false;
      }
      var list = String(patterns)
        .split(/\r?\n/)
        .map(function (p) { return p.trim(); })
        .filter(function (p) { return p !== ''; });
      return list.some(function (p) { return matchesPattern(currentPath, p); });
    }

    if (shouldHideButton(window.location.pathname, excludePatterns)) {
      ctaEl.style.display = 'none';
      return;
    }

    var loginUrl = ctaEl.dataset.loginUrl;

    
    function getShopifySessionId() {
      try {
        var cookies = document.cookie.split('; ');
        for (var i = 0; i < cookies.length; i++) {
          if (cookies[i].indexOf('_shopify_s=') === 0) {
            return decodeURIComponent(cookies[i].substring(11));
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      return null;
    }

    ctaEl.addEventListener('click', function() {
      
      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('yotpo-loyalty-spotlight-cta-clicked', {
        detail: { ctaText: ctaEl.textContent.trim(), pageType: "product" }
      }));
      

      if (!loginUrl) {
        document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('yotpo-loyalty-spotlight-open-drawer'));
        return;
      }

      var current = new URL(window.location.href);
      current.searchParams.set('openSpotlightDrawer', 'true');
      var returnPath = current.pathname + current.search;

      
      var shopifySessionId = getShopifySessionId();
      if (shopifySessionId) {
        try {
          sessionStorage.setItem('yotpo-loyalty-spotlight-cta-login-' + shopifySessionId, Date.now().toString());
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      
      
        var pathOnly = loginUrl.includes('://')
          ? new URL(loginUrl).pathname
          : loginUrl.split('?')[0];
        var isLegacy = pathOnly.includes('/account/login');

        if (isLegacy) {
          var target = new URL(loginUrl, window.location.origin);
          target.searchParams.set('return_url', returnPath);
          window.location.href = target.toString();
        } else {
          var target = new URL('/customer_authentication/login', window.location.origin);
          target.searchParams.set('return_to', returnPath);
          window.location.href = target.toString();
        }
      
    });

    
    document.addEventListener('yotpo-loyalty-spotlight-drawer-ready', function() {
      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('yotpo-loyalty-spotlight-cta-exposed', {
        detail: {
          ctaText: ctaEl.textContent.trim(),
          pageType: "product"
        }
      }));
    }, { once: true });
    

    
      
    
  })();
</script>

    var instanceId = 1302067;

    function init() {
      var customization = window.yotpoWidgetsContainer && window.yotpoWidgetsContainer.shopifySpotlightDrawerCustomization;

      if (!customization) {
        console.debug('[Spotlight Trigger] No customization found, skipping widget container creation');
        return;
      }

      var selector = 'div[data-yotpo-instance-id="' + instanceId + '"]';
      if (document.querySelector(selector)) {
        return;
      }

      var div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = 'yotpo-widget-instance';
      div.setAttribute('data-yotpo-instance-id', instanceId);
      div.setAttribute('data-store-id', "r7VJtcNaKlSBUUPkMAWFUQmtwFynSl01utxmvSdA");
      div.setAttribute('data-merchant-id', "128264");
      div.setAttribute('data-customer-id', "");
      div.setAttribute('data-customer-email', "");

      

      

      Object.keys(customization).forEach(function(key) {
        var dataKey = 'data-' + key.replace(/([A-Z])/g, '-$1').toLowerCase();
        div.setAttribute(dataKey, customization[key]);
      });

      console.debug('[Spotlight Trigger] Widget container created with customization', customization);

      

      document.body.appendChild(div);
      console.debug('[Spotlight Trigger] Widget container appended with customization', div.dataset);

      if (window.yotpoWidgetsContainer && window.yotpoWidgetsContainer.initWidget) {
        console.debug('[Spotlight Trigger] Widget Initializer is ready, init widget');
        window.yotpoWidgetsContainer.initWidget(instanceId, div);
      }
    }

    
    function checkPostLoginAutoOpen(isLoggedIn) {
      var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      var hasParam = params.has('openSpotlightDrawer');

      
      var hasStorageMarker = false;
      var markerValue = null;
      var storageMarkerKey = null;
      try {
        var cookies = document.cookie.split('; ');
        for (var i = 0; i < cookies.length; i++) {
          if (cookies[i].indexOf('_shopify_s=') === 0) {
            var sessionId = decodeURIComponent(cookies[i].substring(11));
            storageMarkerKey = 'yotpo-loyalty-spotlight-cta-login-' + sessionId;
            markerValue = sessionStorage.getItem(storageMarkerKey);
            hasStorageMarker = markerValue !== null;
            break;
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {}

      if (!hasParam && !hasStorageMarker) return;

      
      if (hasParam) {
        params.delete('openSpotlightDrawer');
        var clean = window.location.pathname + (params.toString() ? '?' + params.toString() : '');
        history.replaceState(null, '', clean);
      }

      if (storageMarkerKey) {
        try { sessionStorage.removeItem(storageMarkerKey); } catch (e) {}
      }

      if (!isLoggedIn) return;

      
      if (hasStorageMarker) {
        var clickTs = parseInt(markerValue, 10);
        if (clickTs > 0) {
          var nowMs = Date.now();
          document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('yotpo-loyalty-spotlight-cta-login-success', {
            detail: {
              timeToLoginSeconds: Math.round((nowMs - clickTs) / 1000),
              loginTimestamp: new Date(nowMs).toISOString(),
              pageType: "product"
            }
          }));
        }
      }

      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('yotpo-loyalty-spotlight-open-drawer'));
    }

    document.addEventListener('yotpo-loyalty-spotlight-drawer-ready', function() {
      console.debug('[Spotlight Trigger] Drawer ready event received');
      checkPostLoginAutoOpen(false);
    }, { once: true });

    document.addEventListener('yotpo-loyalty-spotlight-customizations-loaded', function() {
      init();
    }, { once: true });
  })();
</script>
